name: Miim
summary: A custom geometric م, the first letter of مواقيت. Arabic identity becomes the entire symbol.
why: The compact head and descending stroke preserve the structure of an isolated Arabic miim. Broad geometry gives the letter a contemporary silhouette, while a gold face gives its head the feel of a folded plane. مواقيت connects the mark directly to prayer times.
risk: It relies on recognition of the Arabic letter and does not illustrate the app's functions by itself.
